registration.statement: An inorganic reaction network retains every species and every ordered transition. Lewis joining carries exactly two held electron occurrences from provider to acceptor and retains the resulting adduct composition. Redox carries one positive complete held electron support from donor to acceptor, so oxidation and reduction are one conserved transfer and exact reversal swaps endpoints without signed arithmetic.
